articles.title: ‘Utterly baffled’: the 17-year-old girl who struck out Babe Ruth and Lou Gehrig
articles.summary: In a 1931 exhibition, Jackie Mitchell silenced the greats back-to-back. It sparked still-ongoing debates over legitimacy and opportunities for women in baseball. The Sultan of Swat sounded exasperated. “I don’t know what things are coming to,” Babe Ruth sighed during spring training in 1931.
body: “I don’t know what’s going to happen if they begin to let women in baseball,” he elaborated to reporters. “Of course, they will never make good. Why? Because they are too delicate. It would kill them to play ball everyday.”
The next day, Ruth and Lou Gehrig were struck out back-to-back by a 17-year-old girl.

Making their way home from preseason in Florida, the New York Yankees had stopped off in Tennessee for an exhibition game against the minor-league Chattanooga Lookouts. The Lookouts handed a debut to a promising young pitcher with precise control, a quirky side-arm delivery and a vicious sinker. Her name was Jackie Mitchell.
The strikeouts of two all-time greats sparked still-ongoing debates over the legitimacy of Mitchell’s achievement and the general lack of opportunities for female players.

It sparked still-ongoing debates over legitimacy and opportunities for women in baseball.

articles.title: Beaugrand wins again in Weihai as Potter second
articles.summary: France's Cassandre Beaugrand earns her fourth straight win in the World Triathlon Championship Series as Britain's Beth Potter comes second in Weihai.
body: France's Cassandre Beaugrand earned her fourth straight win in the World Triathlon Championship Series as Britain's Beth Potter came second in Weihai.
Olympic champion Beaugrand surged away in the final kilometre of the 10km run to finish in one minute 49.20 seconds and maintain her perfect record in this season's Championship Series.
Beaugrand's victory in China followed a thrilling tussle up until the final stretch, as Olympic bronze medalist Potter finished six seconds behind the 29-year-old.
"I was feeling great on the swim, great on the bike. The run was quite hard with Beth pushing the pace. I just tried my best to keep up and trust my finish."

articles.title: The tiny town aiming to defy odds in Bundesliga debut
articles.summary: Elversberg has no train station and a population of just 13,000, but its football team have enjoyed a meteoric rise from the regional German leagues to the Bundesliga.
body: In south-west Germany, close to the border of France, lies the small town of Elversberg.
It has no railway station and a population of just 13,000, but on Saturday it will enjoy a moment of history as its football team plays in the Bundesliga for the first time.
The club have enjoyed a meteoric rise, having gone from the regional leagues in Germany to the top flight in just a few years.
And their coach Vincent Wagner has not played down the enormity of the task ahead for his side.

articles.title: Patrick Vieira names the hardest player he faced as an Arsenal player
articles.summary: Patrick Vieira has named the hardest player he faced while playing for Arsenal as one of their main players during the Premier League era. The Frenchman played a key role for Arsene Wenger’s side, which dominated the English game across several seasons, and was on their books between 1996 and 2005…
body: The former midfielder enjoyed a superb career in England and, in many matches, was the dominant midfield player. However, he faced several opponents who challenged him in different games.
Vieira went on to become one of the best midfielders in the game during his spell at Arsenal and gave the best years of his career to the Gunners before eventually leaving the club.

There were opponents who always gave him a tough time in matches, and the most notable of them all was Roy Keane. It is therefore no surprise that Vieira picked the Manchester United icon as his toughest opponent in club football.

Vieira’s battles with Keane became a notable feature of the Premier League during that era, with both midfielders playing important roles for their respective clubs. Their competitive encounters highlighted the intensity of English football at the time.

body: Lando Norris agreed a contract extension in August 2026 to stay at McLaren until at least the end of 2030, with options to extend beyond that season.
Norris has been with McLaren since his F1 debut in 2019 and became world champion in 2025.
Oscar Piastri signed a new multi-year contract extension ahead of the 2025 F1 season that will keep him at McLaren until the end of 2028.
Officially, Mercedes announced George Russell only for 2026 after speculation throughout last summer.

articles.title: 🎥 Favourite for the Ballon d'Or? Mourinho is clear 🤨
articles.summary: The debate over the Ballon d'Or has exploded once again following the latest remarks from José Mourinho. The Portuguese coach, always direct and unfiltered, shared his own view of what this award really represents in modern football.
body: For "The Special One," the individual trophy should reward pure talent and not just winning titles: "For me, the Ballon d'Or has to go to those players who, when they retire, we miss forever. I miss Maradona, Nazario, Messi, Zizou..."

With his usual irony, Mourinho made it clear that if the criterion is based solely on a season’s collective success, then the dugouts should be the real stars. He therefore sent a direct message about who should be lifting it in that scenario.

"You can't give the Ballon d'Or just because someone won the Champions League or the World Cup. If you want to reward the Champions League, give the Ballon d'Or to Luis Enrique. As for Spain, surely De La Fuente deserves it," the Portuguese manager said about PSG’s and the national team’s campaigns.

However, he insists that the best player on the planet plays in another league: "The best in the world doesn't have to be from PSG or Spain. There are two, three or four, and we know who they are". He also did not hesitate to take a swipe at the awards: "The Ballon d'Or has politics, and once politics gets involved, I don't like it as much."

articles.title: Barcola set to sign Liverpool contract to 2031
articles.summary: Bradley Barcola is set to sign a Liverpool contract to 2031 after the Premier League club reached an agreement with Paris Saint-Germain over the structure of the transfer.
body: Sky Sports reported on Friday that an agreement in principle had been reached for Barcola to move to Anfield in a package worth £120m.
The final discussions had centred over the structure of deal, with Liverpool now set to pay £106m up front and up to £17m in add-ons.
Documents must still be exchanged between the clubs and Barcola must complete a medical, which is expected to take place this weekend.

There had been a gap in valuation between the two clubs earlier in the summer, with PSG previously asking for around £145m for the France international, but the 23-year-old is now set to sign a five-year deal with Andoni Iraola's side.
